source: Regulation (EU) 2023/956, Annex I (CN codes under Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87), cross-checked against the published CBAM goods-scope tables
note: CBAM Annex I goods scope. In the Annex, scope is defined at the HS heading / CN subheading level: an entry covers the heading AND all subheadings under it (e.g. 7208 covers 72081000). The list below carries a representative CN subheading for each in-scope heading so the calculator can resolve common declarations; a production deployment should expand it to every 8-digit CN subheading under the in-scope headings and honour the exclusions in `exclusions`. Iron & steel covers the whole of chapter 72 plus headings 7301-7311, 7318, 7326 and 2601 12; aluminium covers 7601, 7603-7614, 7616; cement 2507 00 80 and 2523; fertilisers 2808 00, 2814, 2834 21, 3102, 3105 (except 3105 60); hydrogen 2804 10; electricity 2716. Confirm against the current Official Journal before production use.
exclusions: 7202 (ferro-alloys: ferro-silicon, ferro-manganese, etc. — not in scope)
7204 (ferrous waste and scrap — not in scope)
3105 60 (fertilisers with only phosphorus and potassium — not in scope)
